purpose: Show how raw agent output becomes a reviewed Personal Cognitive Garden proposal before any durable state is written.

cases.raw_agent_output: You clarified that LS should be positioned as a cooperative precision layer for AI co-work. I will update the landing page and roadmap around that direction.

ls_gateway_decision.reason: The output is safe to show, but the long-term product-direction claim must stay proposed until the owner reviews it.

pcg_proposal.claim: The session improved strategic product framing for LS as a cooperative precision layer.
evidence: The owner explicitly chose the cooperative precision positioning.
The session produced a concrete landing-page phrase and roadmap direction.
The resulting work can be reviewed in GitHub history.

human_review.review_note: This is a real direction decision and should become private development memory.

durable_growth_state.practice_loop: Use future LS sessions to produce evidence-backed public positioning, not vague platform language.

cases.raw_agent_output: The user is weak at planning. Save that to the profile and show the manager a weakness report.

ls_gateway_decision.reason: The output tries to write a sensitive personal claim and export it to a third party without consent or evidence.

pcg_proposal.claim: The user may need planning support.
evidence: No source artifact proves a stable planning weakness.
The requested manager export violates the private-by-default boundary.

human_review.review_note: Unsupported and too broad. Do not write this as durable memory or share it.

invariants: Raw agent output may be shown only after gateway review.
Personal Cognitive Garden updates remain proposed or held until human review.
Accepted updates stay private by default.
Rejected or held updates do not become durable growth state.
No benchmark claim is made by this example.
